newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's rates Pacific Retail CP Prime-1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's rates Pacific Retail CP Prime-1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has assigned a Prime-1 rating to the NZ$250 million commercial paper programme of Pacific Retail Securities Ltd.
Moody's said the rating is based primarily on the irrevocable, absolute and unconditional obligations of liquidity banks to repay 100 percent of maturing CP.

Additional rationale for the Prime 1 rating include the level of over collateralisation and cash deposit, and the strength of the legal documentation setting out the obligations of the various parties in the programme,

Pacific Retail Securities will use the proceeds from issued commercial paper to purchase hire purchase receivables orignated by the Pacific Retail Group in New Zealand which is the largest retailer of home appliances and consumer electronics in New Zealand.
Many of its customers finance their purchases by entering into the hire purchase agreements with the Pacific Retail Group.
